d:
An amateur edit of "Amenochi Loli ~Mesugaki ni Okasaremakuru Ohanashi~" by the talented artist Ameraku. Using two versions, the Chinese uncensored version (662849), and the English censored version (602892), I was able to sloppily make an Uncensored English version.

*Note: I did not write, draw, redraw, nor translate this work (except crappy uncensoring on page 30).
